resources.string: Coulomb is using what every app can read. Connect Shizuku or Sui to add per-app drain, wakelocks and battery health.
Start it in the Shizuku app and Coulomb reconnects on its own. Permissions you already granted keep working.
Coulomb uses it to read battery details the system keeps to itself. It never changes a setting without your tap. You can also grant access once over ADB.
Your Shizuku version can’t authorize apps on Android 17
Use a Shizuku fork that supports this Android version, or Sui. Until then, grant access once over ADB and Coulomb keeps working.
This Shizuku version is too old
It can’t start Coulomb’s helper. Update Shizuku, or grant access once over ADB.
Coulomb’s saved permissions are gone, usually after a system update. Privileges restores them in one tap.
